title: Comfort Club Tenure Bonus on the Replacement System Installations Member Install Credit
content:
# Tenure bonus on the member install credit

**Rule.** The tenure bonus of the member install credit on a Replacement System Installations contract counts the whole months from the Comfort Club agreement's enrollment date to the contract's signing date:

- an agreement with automatic renewal set and at least 60 such months adds $150.00;
- an agreement with automatic renewal set and at least 36 but fewer than 60 such months adds $75.00;
- any other agreement adds no tenure bonus.

The enrollment date and the automatic-renewal setting are read from the agreement in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records; the signing date from the installation project.

## Grid

| Automatic renewal | Whole months, enrollment to signing | Tenure bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Set | 60 or more | $150.00 |
| Set | 36 to 59 | $75.00 |
| Set | Fewer than 36 | None |
| Not set | Any | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical agreements, automatic renewal set)

- Enrolled 2021-03-15, contract signed 2026-03-15: 60 whole months — $150.00.
- Enrolled 2021-03-15, contract signed 2026-03-14: 59 whole months — $75.00.
- Enrolled 2023-03-15, contract signed 2026-03-15: 36 whole months — $75.00.
- Enrolled 2023-03-15, contract signed 2026-03-14: 35 whole months — no bonus.
- Enrolled 2018-06-01 with automatic renewal not set: no bonus, whatever the months.
